reviews.comment: ANSC 320 online with him was such a breeze and a gpa booster. no lockdown exams, and exams were always very clear on canvas. this class was great, i think spent 2 hour every 2 weeks on this class.

Dr. Wiegert is an amazing professor! I didn't even have one of the prerequisites I was supposed to have, and he still let me take the class. He cares about the students and will always help if you ask. I wasn't interested in taking this class, but it turned out to be my favorite class this semester. Highly recommended.

One of my all-time favorite profs. He is a great lecturer - pigs were not something I was very interested in but he made the lectures easy to pay attention to and fun! You can tell he cares a lot about his students and he is very willing to help. Easy class, awesome prof, 10/10 would recommend.

Dr. Wiegert is amazing. Hands down the best professor I’ve had at TAMU. He is extremely knowledgeable and he genuinely cares about his students and their well being. The smaller class size gives him the opportunity to get to know his students and make sure they understand the subject. I’m so glad I took his class.

His class may be about pigs but he is the GOAT. By far one of the best professors I have ever taken at A&M. I am not interested in pigs by the slightest but I left the class with a new respect for the animal. Participate and pay attention to his lectures and you can easily get an A. Super nice dude.

Dr. Wiegert is by far the best professor I had at TAMU. He makes lecture incredibly interesting and covers everything needed to know within lecture. The exams and quizzes are easy to take as long as you attend class and go over the notes before hand. He is very understanding and is always there to help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Wiegert made a topic I wasnt expecting to like (the entire class even) into one of my favorite courses ive taken. He will go the extra mile to help you if you need it. On his exams and quizzes he is extremely fair with grading, and if you attend lectures, the exams and quizzes require almost no studying. He is extremely thorough in his teaching
